one_line: Match every spoken claim to a shot in order: ride, rock, push, open, then the one-line link offer.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static wide shot of a styled toddler corner with a canopy, sofa and flower rug. Voiceover (transcript) and word-by-word subtitles: "כל דבר חדש / שנכנס אליי הביתה / חייב להצדיק". The ride-on appears on the rug at 0:02.
q1_hook.why: A parent's space-and-clutter logic in text and voice from 0:00 (H1, H6, K6), over a calm styled room that sets a taste signal (H8). The product shows at 0:02 but is not handled until 0:04 (S1, H3), and there is no person or face in the first seconds (H4).

beats.what: Styled room, empty rug; the beige ride-on appears at 0:02, then a close-up; the space-logic line in subtitles
beats.why: A relatable premise, then the product

beats.what: A toddler rides and pushes it on the tile floor; "ואז הגיעה הבימבה הזאת, שהיא בימבה 5 ב1"
beats.why: The 5-in-1 claim, with the first use

beats.what: A toddler with a pacifier rocks on it as a seesaw; "אחר כך הפכנו אותה לנדנדה"
Top-down on a rug: hands on the underside; "כהליכון או משטח דחיפה"
beats.why: Use three, shown from a new angle

beats.what: Hands open the seat to reveal the storage compartment; "שאת זה הם הכי אוהבים!"
beats.why: Use four, a hidden feature revealed

beats.what: A toddler rides; handle and wheels in close-up, a finger on the wheels; material, stability, smooth ride
beats.why: Material and quality claims over product close-ups

beats.what: A toddler leans on it, "כמעט ושטוחה לרצפה"; a toddler from behind; "סוף סוף צעצוע שמתאים לאווירה בבית"
beats.why: A safety claim and a design line

beats.what: Product alone on a rug from above; "לקישור תגיבי בתגובות וזה מיד אצלך"
beats.why: A link ask over a clean product shot

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: On screen and said at 0:30: comment to get the link. Caption: "לקישור וקופון תגיבי בתגובות" and "אם חיפשתן מתנה לקראת גיל שנה סידרתי אתכן!". A first-birthday gift idea to send on.
q2_flow.why: Each claim comes with a matching shot, so information rides on movement, a new picture every 2 to 3 s (R3, E2). The five uses make a short list a parent can follow (R7). The Reel ends right after the ask (R1), with a gift angle worth sending (R5).

q3_cta.what: 0:30-0:32, voiced and subtitled: "לקישור תגיבי בתגובות וזה מיד אצלך". Caption: "לקישור וקופון תגיבי בתגובות ⬇️". No keyword, no coupon value.
q3_cta.why: One action, said, shown after the demo and repeated in the caption, with a real reward, a link and a coupon (C1, C2, C6). But there is no keyword, so every comment counts (C3), and the ask is last in the caption, not in its first line (C6).

q4_shown.what: The ride-on alone on a rug 0:02; a toddler riding 0:04-0:08; rocking 0:09-0:11; the underside as a push surface 0:12; the seat opened to storage 0:14; wheels close up 0:19-0:23; a toddler leaning on it 0:24-0:29; the product from above 0:30. No price.
q4_shown.why: Each of five uses is shown as it is claimed (S1), with a toddler using it and a mother vouching in her own words (S6, K8). The material and safety claims are only said (K4). Toddlers' faces appear (S5), and no price is shown (S3).

q5_edit.what: 15 shots in 33.2 s, about 2.2 s each; hard cuts that follow the speech phrase by phrase, with word-by-word subtitles. Four or five different outfits show footage from several days. No speed changes. Ends on the product from above.
q5_edit.why: A cut on each phrase keeps the pace brisk and the message in step with the picture (E2, R3). Synced subtitles carry it muted (E4). It ends on the ask, with no dead tail (E8). Mixed clothes break continuity but go unnoticed at this pace (E2).

q6_topic.what: A 5-in-1 ride-on for a one-year-old that earns its place in a styled home, framed as a first-birthday gift idea.
q6_topic.why: The caption names the first-birthday moment and its buyer, so it ties to a buying occasion (K7), and clutter worries are a real home concern (K6). Claims such as "special material" are broad and not checkable (K4).

q7_filmed.what: A static wide of a styled room, then handheld mediums and top-downs of a toddler on tile; high-angle close-ups of the underside and the seat on a ribbed rug; a close-up of wheels with a hand. Daylight.
q7_filmed.why: A real home, daylight and a handheld phone look native (H8, F7), and close-ups of the seat and wheels fill the frame and show how it works (F4, F5). The subtitles sit low, over the toddler's legs (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: Small white bold subtitles with a light shadow, centred about 85% down, two to four words at a time: "כל דבר חדש" (0:00), "חייב להצדיק" (0:02), "בימבה 5 ב1" (0:05), "כהליכון או משטח דחיפה." (0:12), "היא קלה ויציבה ברמות!" (0:20), "סוף סוף צעצוע שמתאים לאווירה בבית!!" (0:29), "לקישור תגיבי בתגובות וזה מיד אצלך." (0:30). No headline card.
q8_text.caption: "סוףסוףףףף יש בימבה שהיא גם יפה וגם איכותית !!". About 80 words: benefits, the product name, a gift-for-age-one line, the ask for a link and coupon, "#פרסום בשיתוף פלפוט", 3 hashtags.
q8_text.why: Subtitles of every line let a muted viewer follow (T1), but they are small, full-sentence and in the bottom 35% (T2, T4, T5). The caption has product and occasion keywords and hashtags (T7). The disclosure is a hashtag with words, at the end of the caption (T8, S7).

weak_points: Material and safety claims only said; no keyword in the comment ask; no coupon value; disclosure only as a hashtag at the end of the caption; toddlers' faces; subtitles small and low in the frame.
lumebook_takeaway: Say one parent-logic line over a styled corner, show each book feature as claimed in 2 to 3 s cuts, and end on the cover with a comment-for-link line.
not_verified: Whether the voiceover was recorded after filming. The coupon value. Whether the same toddler appears throughout: the outfits and hair differ at 0:04, 0:06, 0:09 and 0:11. Music is not evident. Correction to src/coded: the product is on screen from 0:02 but unhandled, and it is handled from 0:04. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
